# Testwiz Anatomy: public knowledge bundle

## Product summary

Testwiz Anatomy is a browser-based interactive 3D human anatomy atlas designed for medical, nursing, midwifery, and allied-health students. The public pages explain anatomy concepts and link into the interactive viewer. The viewer itself is available through any active Testwiz Pro subscription, tied to the learner's Testwiz account.

## Learning workflow

1. Preview an anatomy region or system.
2. Search a named structure or a common alias.
3. Rotate the model and compare front, side, and back views.
4. Isolate or explode layers to understand relationships.
5. Read the concise structure and nursing-focus notes.
6. Test recall with Entity Q&A or Identify Mode.
7. Return to missed structures using local review history.

## Edition and data scope

The male reference uses BodyParts3D 4.0. The female reference uses the Human Reference Atlas female v1.10 GLB and retains eight pelvic structures from v1.5. The female reference is a whole-body orientation surface with selected organs and incomplete skeletal and muscular coverage. Pregnancy reference structures are hidden until enabled. The product documents these limits rather than presenting the female edition as a one-to-one mesh equivalent of the male edition.

## Public educational pages

- https://anatomy.testwiz.ng/blog/anatomical-planes-directions/ — anatomical position, planes, and directional language.
- https://anatomy.testwiz.ng/blog/heart-anatomy/ — chambers, valves, pulmonary/systemic circulation, coronary circulation, and nursing landmarks.
- https://anatomy.testwiz.ng/blog/brain-anatomy/ — cerebral lobes, brainstem, cerebellum, meninges, and neurologic assessment links.
- https://anatomy.testwiz.ng/blog/female-reproductive-system/ — ovaries, uterine tubes, uterus, cervix, vagina, mammary glands, and 3D study steps.
- https://anatomy.testwiz.ng/blog/how-to-study-anatomy/ — a preview, explore, retrieve, apply, and spaced-review study loop.
- https://anatomy.testwiz.ng/blog/human-body-systems/ — systems overview and system-versus-region learning strategy.
- https://anatomy.testwiz.ng/blog/3d-anatomy-atlas-medical-students/ — a student checklist for search, layers, sex-specific coverage, active recall, performance, and account access.

## Safety and accuracy

Content is educational and should be checked against the learner's current course text, lecturer, and local clinical protocols. It is not a diagnostic, treatment, or surgical planning service.

## Publisher
